source: The Builder's Practical Director, Plate 118, description on PDF page 518

massing.plan: open floors on cast iron columns

notes: Not a dwelling, and here because a town has these in it. Internal dimensions 62 by 54 feet, three floors and a basement, storey heights 12, 14, 14 and 12. Only the ground floor is described room by room; the upper floors are open space on cast iron columns. The design argument is about elevation: 'We have avoided in the elevation that absurd practice of introducing a number of small separate windows giving a dwelling house appearance to Factories and Warehouses, and conveying the idea that the interior is divided into a number of separate apartments.' 3400 pounds.
